NCT03816657.brief_title: The Predictive Role of Programmed Death Ligand 1 (PD-L1) and Neutrophil to Lymphocyte Ratio (NLR) in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)
NCT03816657.brief_summary: This retrospective study explores the combination of Programmed cell death ligand 1 (PD-L1) expression and Neutrophil to Lymphocyte Ratio (NLR) as an easy feasible panel to predict benefit to nivolumab.
NCT03816657.eligibility_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with histologic diagnosis of advanced NSCLC who received Nivolumab as second or further line of therapy
* Paraffin-embedded tissue sample available for PD-L1 analysis
* disponibilità di emocromo entro 4 settimane dall'inizio del trattamento con Nivolumab
* To calculate NLR, the absolute neutrophil count was divided by the lymphocytes value measured in peripheral blood within 4 weeks prior to the first infusion of nivolumab.

No main Exclusion Criteria
conditions: To Define an Easy and Feasible Panel Which May be Routinely Applied to Select Patients for Immunotherapy Avoiding More Complex and Expensive Methods
